Transforms info received by Reliability.SensorsGrid Grid.
Used to:
Add new field displayNumOpenAlerts which is equal to Sensor#numOpenSensorAlerts if that value is
greater than 0, otherwise it is an empty string.
When a sensor in SensorOperationalStatusEnum#FAULTY status has an existing SensorOperationalStatusTimedValue#endDate,
a new field is created by concatenating the locally formatted date with a translated prefix.
If there is any Sensor without an Sensor#operationalStatus, add a default value so that they are treated as
SensorOperationalStatusEnum#OPERATIONAL in the UI.
